_title: dossiq: admin settings in Nextcloud, advanced tab
_note: What you see: the last tab of the Dossiq page in the Nextcloud admin settings (/settings/admin/dossiq?tab=advanced): ZGW API connection, KCC workplace, decision tables, penalty callback, StUF-ZKN, Marketplace register, first run, requirements, what dossiq ships, tenant onboarding, case type management, AWB terms, urgency, mandate matrix, archiving and Woo reports.
_title_nl: dossiq: beheerinstellingen in Nextcloud, tab geavanceerd
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: het laatste tabblad van de pagina Dossiq in de Nextcloud-beheerinstellingen (/settings/admin/dossiq?tab=advanced): ZGW-API-koppeling, KCC-werkplek, beslistabellen, dwangsom-callback, StUF-ZKN, Marktplaatsregister, eerste keer, vereisten, wat dossiq meelevert, tenant-onboarding, zaaktypebeheer, AWB-termijnen, urgentie, mandaatmatrix, archivering en Woo-rapportages.
dossiq: beheerinstellingen in Nextcloud,: dossiq: administration settings in Nextcloud, advanced tab
geldt voor de hele organisatie; instelli: applies to the whole organisation; settings you set once or with a specialist
Configureer eigenschapstoewijzingen tuss: Configure property mappings between English OpenRegister fields and Dutch ZGW API fields
Documenttype van het zaaktype: Document type of the case type
Burgeridentificatie, voorblad-limieten,: Citizen identification, cover sheet limits, sentiment trigger words and call plan overflow thresholds for the KCC contact centre bridge.
Stel in hoe de KCC-werkplekbrug burgers: Set how the KCC workstation bridge identifies citizens, opens the case cover sheet, scores sentiment and routes calls. DigiD authentication and the telephony screen pop are provided by Integriq and pipelinq respectively; only the Dossiq part is configured here.
Of burgers worden geïdentificeerd via Di: Whether citizens are identified through DigiD (portal/chat), identification questions (phone), or both.
Minimale matchscore voor identificatievr: Minimum match score for identification questions to link a citizen and show full case information. Below the threshold only public case information is shown.
Max. open zaken in voorblad: Max. open cases on cover sheet
Belplan overflowdrempel: wachttijd (seco: Call plan overflow threshold: waiting time (seconds)
Belplan overflowdrempel: wachtrijlengte: Call plan overflow threshold: queue length
Nederlandse woorden die negatief sentime: Dutch words that mark negative sentiment and trigger an escalation recommendation. One word or phrase per line.
De stand van de zoekindex van OpenRegist: The state of OpenRegister's search index, read when the page opens. Dossiq keeps no copy of it.
Met snapshot, restore en report als ande: With snapshot, restore and report as the other verbs of the same command.
Als OpenRegister niet antwoordt, staat h: When OpenRegister does not answer, this says what went wrong instead of a table of zeroes. It looks like this:
OpenRegister antwoordt niet: GET /apps/o: OpenRegister does not answer: GET /apps/openregister/api/settings/search-index returned 503 Service Unavailable. Try again later; search in the app keeps working as long as the index itself runs.
Beslistabellen staan in het register dec: Decision tables are stored in the decision-tables register of OpenRegister. Dossiq keeps its own tables there under keys that start with dossiq. and evaluates them from workflow steps and the enforcement advice. Open OpenRegister to read or change a table.
Configureer het gedeelde geheim waarmee: Configure the shared secret used to validate ERP payment confirmation callbacks for penalty payment disbursements.

Configure the shared secret used to validate the X-Procest-Signature HMAC-SHA256 header on the public penalty payment confirmation callback (/apps/dossiq/api/dwangsom/payment-callback). Without a configured secret every callback request is rejected (HTTP 401). An unconfigured secret is never treated as an implicit approval.
Er is geen callbackgeheim ingesteld. Elk: No callback secret has been set. Every disbursement confirmation is now rejected with HTTP 401.
Gedeeld HMAC-SHA256-ondertekeningsgeheim: Shared HMAC-SHA256 signing secret. Give this value to the ERP/Integriq integrator so they can sign X-Procest-Signature headers.
Uitgaande StUF-ZKN/BG-zaaksysteemendpoin: Outgoing StUF-ZKN/BG case system endpoints per municipality, with circuit breaker status per endpoint. Endpoints, WSSE credentials and mTLS certificates are managed by the platform administrator.
Endpoints, inloggegevens (WSSE) en mTLS-: Endpoints, credentials (WSSE) and mTLS certificates are managed by the platform administrator. Contact your administrator to add or rotate them.
Auditlog per aanroep voor uitgaande en i: Audit log per call for outgoing and incoming StUF SOAP envelopes (full XML, HTTP status, duration, retry history).
Geen StUF-berichten voldoen aan de filte: No StUF messages match the filters.
Verbind de OpenRegister-instantie die de: Connect the OpenRegister instance that the Marketplace page searches. Without a connection dossiq stays offline and shows only its own templates.
Een marktplaatsregister is een andere Op: A marketplace register is another OpenRegister instance that publishes case configuration. Leave the address empty to keep dossiq offline: nothing is fetched from the network while there is no address.
Het token wordt na opslaan nooit meer ge: The token is never shown again after saving. Leave it empty to keep the saved token.
Wat deze omgeving nog nodig heeft voorda: What this environment still needs before a case can go in. We report it, we do not require it. Restore the register with the Reimport configuration button.
Zaken, documenten en kalenders hangen aa: Cases, documents and calendars belong to an organisation. OpenRegister stores it.
Kies de gedeelde mailbox waaruit de app: Choose the shared mailbox the app sends from and reads case mail from.
Elke zaak volgt een zaaktype. Een concep: Every case follows a case type. A draft type does not accept cases.
Een rol zonder iemand erin beslist niets: A role with nobody in it decides nothing. Give at least one role a holder.
Termijnen tellen in werkdagen. Zonder ka: Deadlines count in working days. Without a calendar every deadline is a guess.
Wat dossiq nodig heeft om te draaien, en: What dossiq needs to run, and what this instance has. Read live, every time you open this page.
Leest en schrijft elke registerinhoud en: Reads and writes all register content and every manifest.
Telt en knipt tekst die geen platte ASCI: Counts and cuts text that is not plain ASCII, in 19 services.
Packs and unpacks a case type export.
Bewaart elke zaak, elk zaaktype en elk o: Stores every case, every case type and every object of dossiq.
Verstuurt en ontvangt over de gemeenteli: Sends and receives over the municipal connections.
Maakt en anonimiseert de documenten bij: Creates and anonymises the documents of a case.
Boekt de uren die een behandelaar op een: Books the hours a case handler logs on a case.
Neemt een besluit dat een commissie nodi: Takes a decision that needs a committee.
Shows the applicant their own case.
Draait de intake- en routeringspijplijne: Runs the intake and routing pipelines.
Geeft de app de huisstijl van het overhe: Gives the app the house style of the government design system.
Elk zaaktype, elke status, elk resultaat: Every case type, every status, every result and every role that dossiq placed, and whether you have changed it since. A newer shipped version is offered per object and never overwrites a change of yours.
Volg een tenant door de zeven onboarding: Take a tenant through the seven onboarding steps, run the go-live readiness check and activate the tenant. One-time set-up, so it belongs here and not in the daily navigation.
Selecteer een tenant om de onboarding-vo: Select a tenant to view the onboarding progress.
Zaaktypen, met hun statussen, velden, be: Case types, with their statuses, fields, messages and workflow, are managed on the Case types page.
Configureer wettelijke termijndefinities: Configure statutory deadline definitions per case type for Awb deadline monitoring (legal basis, duration, validity). Versioning is enforced on save.
Dagen en datums worden geteld in Europe/: Days and dates are counted in Europe/Amsterdam.
Servicenorm, geen wettelijke beslistermi: Service standard, no statutory decision deadline
Wanneer een zaak kritiek of bijna is, en: When a case is critical or nearly so, and how heavily priority and inactivity weigh in the order.
Bepaalt de volgorde van de zaken die aan: Sets the order of the cases assigned to someone. A case type can set the two thresholds itself.
Kritiek vanaf, werkdagen voor de termijn: Critical from, working days before the deadline
Bijna vanaf, werkdagen voor de termijn: Nearly from, working days before the deadline
Punten per stap van laag naar spoed, 0 t: Points per step from low to urgent, 0 to 50. Default 10.
Punten per dag zonder activiteit, 0 tot: Points per day without activity, 0 to 1,5. Default 0,5.
Configureer mandaatbesluiten, organisati: Configure mandate decisions, organisation roles, role assignments and import old mandate exports
Afdelingen en externe instanties die een: Departments and external bodies that can receive an advice request. Each body is an object in OpenRegister; when asking for advice a handler searches here by name or specialism.
Op \"brand\" staan de 3 instanties met s: On "brand" the 3 bodies with specialism fire safety come first; all 15 stay selectable.
5 van 15. Een externe instantie zonder N: 5 of 15. An external body without a Nextcloud account gets the request by e-mail: number, subject, question, term and a secure reply link to upload the advice and choose the outcome.
Het register van datalekken (avgIncident: The register of data breaches (avgIncident). Only who holds the role permission privacy sees this tab and reads the register; every employee can report a breach.
Je ziet dit tabblad omdat je in dossiq-p: You see this tab because you are in dossiq-privacy. An employee in dossiq-medewerkers only does not see the tab Data breaches, and OpenRegister refuses their read of avgIncident.
Exporteren voor de Autoriteit Persoonsge: Export for the Dutch Data Protection Authority
Mail met bijlage naar verkeerd adres: Mail with attachment to the wrong address
Woo-besluit met ongelakte naam gepublice: Woo decision published with an unredacted name
Hoe vaak een beoordelaar wordt herinnerd: How often a reviewer is reminded of the archive decisions waiting for them. The setting is in OpenRegister, which runs the archiving process; dossiq keeps no copy of it.
Een ISO 8601-duur, bijvoorbeeld P7D voor: An ISO 8601 duration, for example P7D for every seven days.
Kies welke Woo-beoordelingsrapportages j: Choose which Woo review reports your organisation uses, and who may read the output per reviewer.
Beide rapportages staan uit tot je ze aa: Both reports are off until you turn them on. The output report counts what each reviewer did per day, so only the group you name may read it.
Lezersgroep voor de productierapportage: Reader group for the output report
Het id van een bestaande Nextcloud-groep: The id of an existing Nextcloud group. Administrators outside that group cannot read the report either.
Productie per beoordelaar per dag rappor: Report output per reviewer per day
Verzamelde mail rapporteren per afzender: Report collected mail per sender, recipient and domain
Het overzicht voor de functionaris gegev: The overview for the data protection officer, limited to dossiq's registers. Whoever lacks the DPO role gets no access from OpenRegister.
Je ziet dit onderdeel omdat je de FG-rol: You see this section because you hold the DPO role. An administrator without it gets: No access to dossiq's processing activities.
Export door het platform, met doel en gr: Export by the platform, with purpose and legal basis per entry
De export maakt OpenRegister, beperkt to: OpenRegister produces the export, limited to dossiq's registers, and logs the export itself.
Een meegeleverde set roltypen: behandela: A shipped set of role types: handler, coordinator, team lead, intake, archive and reader. Dormant until an administrator adopts it; one act, recorded with who and when.
In gebruik genomen door Anouk Bakker op: Adopted by Anouk Bakker on 3 Oct 2026. Before that date this read: Dormant, with the button Adopt; after undoing, the set is dormant again.
Ongedaan maken geweigerd: de rol Behande: Undo refused: the role Handler is in use (12 grants). Remove those grants first.
